description: The bar chart presents execution accuracy values for two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four task categories to illustrate how each system performs by task complexity and in aggregate. The horizontal axis contains the categorical labels “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” on a linear scale with visible tick marks at 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 (spanning roughly from 20 up to the low-to-mid 60s). Each category shows a grouped pair of vertical bars: NatSQL is shown in a light blue bar and TA-SQL in a darker blue bar, as indicated by the legend at the top. In “Simple,” NatSQL is labeled 60.21 and TA-SQL is labeled 63.14; in “Moderate,” NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; in “Challenging,” NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and in “Total,” NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are not displayed in a sorted order by value but follow the category sequence shown on the x-axis, and each bar has its numeric value annotated above it without additional visual emphasis such as outlines or shading beyond the two-color scheme.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest margin observed in the Moderate category, where TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 compared to NatSQL's 39.64. In the Challenging category, TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11, while NatSQL remains stable at 32.32. Overall, TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels, culminating in a total accuracy of 58.19, which is significantly higher than NatSQL's 51.35.
